mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 3.8% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the probability of central bank rate cuts and triggers a flight to equity risk premia, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 3.8% for three consecutive months, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts below 1.5 million units in a month signals weakening consumer demand and a contraction in residential investment, which triggers a policy response from the Fed and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST falls below 1500.0, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 108.0 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which increases the likelihood of monetary stimulus and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during INDPRO < 108.0 periods, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, which increases the probability of aggressive Fed intervention and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS fall below thresholds, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.8% and the federal funds rate is below 2.0%, it indicates a lagged monetary policy stance that fails to contain inflation, prompting market expectations of future rate hikes and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.8 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate above 3.7% and a decline in non-farm payrolls below 150,000 jobs signals a labor market slowdown, which increases the likelihood of Fed rate cuts and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both UNRATE > 3.7 and PAYEMS < 150000.0, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 525,000 million dollars combined with a decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized signals a weakening economy, which triggers fiscal or monetary stimulus and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS < 525000.0 and GDPC1 < 1.5%, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
